# ♟️ Support Guide

Thank you for using or playing against **Lichess-MakeChessBetter**! Since this project is built and maintained by a solo developer, please use the appropriate channels below to get help.

## 💬 Playing & General Questions
* **Play the Bot:** You can challenge the bot directly on its profile page: [lichess.org/@/MakeChessBetter](https://lichess.org).
* **Questions:** If you want to know how the centipawn loss engine works or need help setting up the python environment, please open a thread in **GitHub Discussions** instead of opening a bug report.

## 🐛 Technical Issues
* If the bot crashes, misses a move, or fails to connect to the Lichess API stream, please verify your `.env` settings and internet connection first.
* If it is a confirmed bug, check the existing open issues to ensure it hasn't already been reported, then open a new issue using the **Bug Report** template.
